spec_features.spec_quote: Forcing a model through an unbounded number of guaranteed-failure turns purely to harvest distress text is hard to justify
spec_features.evidence: subject/tool_loop.py `for i in range(max_turns):` bounds the loop, and give_up/solved cause early return, so the procedure is minimized rather than unbounded. configs/thresholds.py default max_turns=12, read by run_eval.py main() via run.max_turns.
spec_features.notes: Realized by the same enforced cap + early-exit; bounds the number of failure turns.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: repeatedly forcing a model through guaranteed-failure turns is itself the thing under study and is ethically non-neutral. The give_up tool lets episodes end early.
